options.nvidia_dlss.sharpening.tooltip: Separate NVIDIA NIS NVSharpen pass after DLSS and before HUD/GUI. Automatic DLAA and Quality keep it off because sharpening can amplify foliage shimmer.
options.nvidia_dlss.sharpening.amount.to: 0 to 100 percent; internally capped at 0.5 NIS sharpness to limit halos.
options.nvidia_dlss.tooltip.ready: NVIDIA Streamline is ready. DLSS requires Vulkan and a supported NVIDIA RTX GPU.
options.nvidia_dlss.tooltip.restart_requ: Restart required: this process started with DLSS off and without Streamline. The requested setting was saved and will activate on the next normal launch.
options.nvidia_dlss.tooltip.vr: Vivecraft VR is active. The experimental desktop render path is disabled to protect VR output.
options.nvidia_dlss.screen.title: BlockFrame DLSS / DLAA
blockframe.safe_start.offer.tooltip: A previous run ended incompletely. You can explicitly queue a one-shot Safe Start for the next launch without changing normal settings.
blockframe.safe_start.confirm.title: Queue BlockFrame Safe Start?
blockframe.safe_start.confirm.message: The next Minecraft process will use existing Mojang and legacy fallbacks for optional BlockFrame features once. The current process and your normal configuration, quality, content, and view distance remain unchanged.
blockframe.safe_start.queued.title: Safe Start queued
blockframe.safe_start.queued.message: The one-shot Safe Start will be consumed by the next Minecraft process. Restart when convenient; this process continues unchanged.
blockframe.safe_start.failed.title: Safe Start unavailable
blockframe.safe_start.failed.message: The one-shot marker could not be stored safely. Nothing was changed and this process continues normally.
